rationale: The run landed on the corporate site (monclergroup.com) brand page, which has no product tiles. This is a domain-level misnavigation rather than a selector issue. Prioritizing overrides: we block the corporate domain, normalize locales to a stable /en-us/, and rewrite any /en/brands/moncler paths back to the commerce site. We also add minimal click blocklists to avoid menu items that route to corporate pages. Selectors are left unchanged because the immediate failure is reaching a non-PLP page.
code_hints: Add a host guard after any navigation: if new URL host is not in host_allowlist, abort and navigate to overrides.fallback_entry_urls[0].
Before clicking any anchor, skip if anchor.href matches url_blocklist_patterns or contains a blocked host.
On response redirect, if final_url.host ends with monclergroup.com, do not follow; instead load https://www.moncler.com/en-us/.
Implement a locale normalizer: replace any /en-xx/ with /en-us/ before queueing the URL.
Add a quick stray-page detector: if document.title includes 'Moncler Group' or body contains 'Brands/Moncler', treat as non-PLP and jump to fallback_entry_urls[0].
